from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ISCAM = ROOT / 'backend/modules/inteligencia_comercial/iscam_routes.py'


def _text():
    return ISCAM.read_text(encoding='utf-8')


def test_resumen_cuentas_none_uses_safe_iso_serialization():
    text = _text()
    start = text.index('@iscam_router.get("/cuentas")')
    end = text.index('@iscam_router.get("/cuentas/detalle")', start)
    block = text[start:end]
    assert '"fecha": _iso(r["fecha"])' in block
    assert 'r["fecha"].isoformat() if r["fecha"] else None' not in block
    assert 'Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' in block
    assert 'fecha_operacion >= %s AND fecha_operacion < %s' in block
    assert 'ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1' in block


def test_product_ticket_drill_uses_safe_iso_serialization():
    text = _text()
    start = text.index('@iscam_router.get("/ventas-periodos/tickets")')
    end = text.index('# ============================================================================\n# 2) RESUMEN DE CUENTAS', start)
    block = text[start:end]
    assert '"fecha": _iso(r["fecha"])' in block
    assert 'r["fecha"].isoformat() if r["fecha"] else None' not in block
    assert 'Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' in block
    assert 'ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1' in block


def test_no_remaining_direct_row_fecha_isoformat():
    assert 'r["fecha"].isoformat() if r["fecha"] else None' not in _text()
